name: Scale-like
description: Tiny overlapping scales pressed flat against the twig.

name: Simple, untoothed
description: One blade per stalk with a smooth unbroken edge.

name: Simple, toothed
description: One blade per stalk with teeth along the edge.

name: Simple, lobed
description: One blade per stalk cut into lobes by sinuses.

name: Pinnately compound
description: Leaflets in two rows along a central stalk.

name: Palmately compound
description: Leaflets spread from one point like fingers.

name: Fan / strap
description: Long strap blades or fan blades, as on palms and yuccas.

name: Smooth
description: An unbroken surface with no ridges or plates.

name: Furrowed / ridged
description: Long ridges separated by deep vertical grooves.

name: Plated / blocky
description: The surface breaks into square or rectangular plates.

name: Shaggy / strip-peeling
description: Long strips lift away at one or both ends.

name: Papery / exfoliating
description: Thin sheets or flakes peel off and show a paler layer.

name: Warty / lenticelled
description: Raised corky bumps or horizontal lenticel lines.

name: Samara
description: A dry seed with a papery wing.

name: Acorn
description: A single nut seated in a scaly cup.

name: Nut / husk
description: A hard nut inside a thick husk that splits.

name: Pod / legume
description: A flat or round pod holding a row of seeds.

name: Berry / drupe
description: A fleshy fruit around one stone or several seeds.

name: Capsule
description: A dry case that splits open along seams.

name: Cone
description: Overlapping scales on an axis, woody or fleshy.
